_comment: REFERENCE ONLY - there is NO ACTIVE RULE here. Bionic Reader used to redirect main-frame .pdf navigations into the viewer in-place via a dynamic declarativeNetRequest rule. That replaced the original page, so it was removed: background.js now detects PDF navigations and opens the viewer in a NEW TAB instead, leaving the originating tab untouched. The declarativeNetRequest permission is retained only so background.js can delete the stale legacy dynamic rule (id 1) from older installs.
